narrative: -  This has been a disaster of a team from the beginning of the league so I went out to find a solid owner from a previous league I was in. Roy took over in the rookie draft of 2009 and didn't leave until after the 2016 season. 8 seasons! Finally a solid owner. He lives in Florida but travels all over the world making it tough to draft and other things involved with the league. But is still more active than most FFers. He was on the bad end of the Most Lopsided game in 2015. No Championships to his name in this league unless you count the Jamarcus Russell trophy in 2014. He had the league MVP in David Johnson in 2016. He was 1-1 in Playoff games. Roy had 3 winning seasons but only made the Playoffs once. He was around .500 winning percentage every year finishing with a 72-80 record.
